_comment: Single committed place for the digital partition's STA corner set (issue #678); #679 cites this file.
operating_points = the nine PVT points sim/digital-partition/ characterizes (docs/characterization-report-digital.md).
Liberty availability was read from the sky130_fd_sc_hd lib/ directory of the PDK the reports were minted against (see the record's provenance).

supplementary_corners = stock liberty files that are NOT among the nine points; they are timed in addition (clearly labelled) because they are the library's own slow/fast/hot extremes. They are never a substitute for a gap above.

operating_points.note: no ff liberty at 27 C / 1.80 V (stock ff files: n40C_1v56/1v65/1v76/1v95, 100C_1v65/1v95). Not substituted.
sky130_fd_sc_hd ships no fs (fast-NMOS/slow-PMOS) liberty at any temperature or voltage. Not substituted.
sky130_fd_sc_hd ships no sf (slow-NMOS/fast-PMOS) liberty at any temperature or voltage. Not substituted.
no ss liberty at 27 C / 1.80 V (stock ss files: n40C_1v28..1v76, 100C_1v40/1v60). Not substituted.
no tt liberty at -40 C (stock tt files: 025C_1v80, 100C_1v80 only). Not substituted.
no tt liberty at 125 C (stock tt files: 025C_1v80, 100C_1v80 only). Not substituted.
no tt liberty at 1.62 V (stock tt files are 1.80 V only). Not substituted.
The library's typical corner is 25 C; the digital characterization's SPICE point is 27 C. The 2 C difference is declared here and in the record, not hidden: this row is a mapping, not an identity.
no tt liberty at 1.98 V (stock tt files are 1.80 V only). Not substituted.

supplementary_corners.role: stock typical-process hot point; 100 C is not the 125 C point
stock slow/hot/low-V point (the library's setup-limiting extreme); not the ss_27c_1.80v point
stock fast/cold/high-V point (the library's hold-limiting extreme); not the ff_27c_1.80v point
